en: Bats are not birds, but mammals that give birth to live young and feed their babies milk.
Plants do not eat soil for energy, but make their own food using sunlight, water, and carbon dioxide.
Spiders are arachnids with eight legs, unlike insects which have six legs and three distinct body segments.
Mushrooms are fungi that absorb nutrients from decaying matter, rather than plants that make food via photosynthesis.
Human blood is always red, appearing bright red when carrying oxygen and dark red when returning to the heart.
Whales are marine mammals that breathe air through blowholes and nurse their calves with milk, unlike fish.
Tree leaves change color in autumn because green chlorophyll breaks down, revealing hidden yellow and orange pigments, not from frost.
Snakes have completely dry, scaly skin to prevent water loss, rather than the slimy skin of amphibians.
Ostriches do not bury their heads in the sand, but actually lay their large eggs in ground nests.
Penguins are flightless birds that possess feathers and lay eggs, rather than fish that have scales and gills.
Frog tadpoles breathe underwater using gills, but adult frogs develop lungs to breathe air as terrestrial amphibians.
Venus flytraps digest insects for scarce soil nutrients, but still produce their main energy through leaf photosynthesis.
